text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 fired for tenant=Nimbus-prod-dedicated — symptom: sustained 95th pct latency >1200ms for /generate over 3m. Autopage attempted and failed to add reserved capacity (autoscaler error). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-tenant-latency

Metrics snapshot (3m):
```
95p_latency: 1250ms
error_rate_5m: 1.8% (502/503s)
kv_cache_evictions/sec: 310
soft_oom_count: 4
autoscaler: scale_attempts=3, last_err=insufficient_gpus_for_quantile
```

Initial recommended actions: ack, verify customer impact, check kvcache & autoscaler logs, consider temporary routing fallback to preserve latency. Pager: https://pagerduty.com/incident/PD123456

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by amanda (on-call). Escalation in 15m if unchanged.

amanda: Acked. I'm on it. I'll pull autoscaler logs + reserved pool state. @ryan please check kv cache eviction spikes, @cs-jordan fyi since CS reported customer 502s.

ryan: digging into KV and GPU logs. Seeing a huge spike in `kv_cache_evictions/sec` matching the latency window. soft_ooms on 2 workers then 2 more. Sample log:```
[2026-03-15T12:01:02Z] worker-7: kv_cache_evicted 128 keys, mem_free=2.1GB
[2026-03-15T12:01:04Z] worker-7: soft_oom triggered, fallback_disk_swap=true
```
Looks like a thundering-herd of long-context requests after the model rollout to gpt-highmem-v1 increased avg seq len.

sam: If autoscaler can't add GPUs fast enough, we can temporarily route this tenant to a lower-memory variant. Plan: flip routing to fallback variant `gpt-mini-v2` for Nimbus to keep p95 reasonable while we remediate. Command I'll run if ok: `redwoodctl route set --tenant Nimbus --policy fallback --variant gpt-mini-v2`

lee: caution — routing to shared/hosted may trigger different rate limits and visible regression. What's the SLA for Nimbus? @cs-jordan

cs-jordan: Nimbus is on reserved monthly with 99.9% latency SLO. They expect dedicated capacity — fallback is acceptable short-term if it preserves responsiveness, but avoid regressions for high-priority customers. I've notified their ops team.

maria: autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts failed with `insufficient_gpus_for_quantile` in region-us-west2. Suggest manual reserved pool bump + drain heavy pod as longer-term fix. `infractl reserved add --tenant Nimbus --instance-type a100-40gb --count 1` (may hit quota).

amanda: I'll try a less disruptive step first: KV cache rebalance to free prefixes for Nimbus. Running: `scripts/redis-kv-rebalance --tenant Nimbus --target 60%` — will report back in a few mins.

ryan: also observed a model rollout for tenant to `gpt-highmem-v1` ~10m ago — sequence length distribution shifted right. We could rollback that rollout for this tenant to reduce memory pressure.

sam: routing flip in 30s (manual fallback) — executing: `redwoodctl route set --tenant Nimbus --policy fallback --variant gpt-mini-v2` -> API responded 202 Accepted. Monitoring metrics now.

incident-bot: Route change detected for tenant Nimbus: policy=fallback, variant=gpt-mini-v2. System will stream latency & error deltas to this thread.

amanda: KV rebalance completed. Eviction rate dropped from 310 -> ~42/sec. soft_oom_count back to 0. p95 latency down to ~800ms (was 1250ms). Holding for stabilization and watching for errors. :white_check_mark:

maria: infractl call to add reserved instance failed: quota_exceeded in us-west2. Opening cloud quota request ticket (CLD-7890) and pinging infra ops.

cs-jordan: Updated customer: "We've applied a temporary internal routing fallback and are seeing improvements; monitoring for next 30m" — they asked for ETA, I told them we'll confirm when stable.

sam: Rolling back model for tenant to previous version (less memory-hungry): `modelctl rollback --tenant Nimbus --model gpt-highmem-v1 --to v0.9` -> response: success.

ryan: Post-rollback metrics: p95=420ms, error_rate back to baseline ~0.1%, kv_evictions down. No new OOMs in last 3m. Looks stable. I'll keep an eye for 20m.

lee: I'll set PagerDuty status to "monitoring" and cancel escalation. If anyone wants to draft a short follow-up (root cause & next steps) for the oncall doc, speak now.

amanda: Thanks team. I'll summarize actions and follow up on quota request and model rollout gating. Leaving thread open for 30m to ensure stability. :thumbsup:
